data_source: Yahoo Finance public screeners and daily prices (via yfinance); SEC EDGAR Company Facts through StockPilot SEC Worker where an exact US filing match exists
data_note: Candidate scan uses Yahoo Finance activity/gainer screeners plus a maintained Canadian TSX/TSXV symbol seed list. This is not an exhaustive scan of every listing. Every seed candidate must still return real daily price history and pass the same liquidity and price filters. Yahoo endpoints are unofficial and data may be delayed. SEC annual fundamentals are included only when an exact SEC ticker match is available; other issuers are explicitly marked market-data-only. Prices use local trading currencies.
strategy: Multi-factor score 0–100. Technical score: 25% trend alignment, 20% 50-day return, 20% 20-day return, 10% 5-day return, 10% relative volume, and 15% liquidity, less a volatility penalty. Where exact SEC annual fundamentals are available, the main-stock score blends 60% filing-based financial health/growth/profitability with 40% technical conditions; penny stocks blend 30% fundamentals with 70% technical conditions. Without SEC fundamentals, the score is technical-only and is explicitly labelled. Main stocks require 20-day average dollar volume of at least $1 million; penny stocks must be $0.05–$10 with at least $100,000 average daily dollar volume. Stock of the Day is selected independently for each market from that market's highest-ranked eligible main stock, with a clearly labelled penny-stock fallback only if necessary.
